submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R2 at 3.0 cm. The simulations show this choice gives about 3.8 sigma pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c, safely above the 3.5 sigma hard requirement. Although Radiator-R1 gives higher raw separation, it is a high-index porous radiator with no humidity-protection feature listed; the hard 10-year humidity-ageing constraint makes the hydrophobic candidate the appropriate choice. Radiator-R3 is humidity-robust in concept as a solid radiator but does not reach the required 3.5 sigma separation in the scanned 1--6 cm range. R2 at 3 cm is therefore the best compliant compromise: it is one of the specified candidates, has the hydrophobic treatment needed for ageing robustness, and sits near the simulated separation maximum while remaining comfortably within the allowed thickness range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Among humidity-compatible options, Radiator-R2 is the only candidate reaching the required performance. Scans of R2 gave ~3.8 sigma near 3 cm: 3.794 sigma at 2 cm, 3.898/3.820/3.876/3.851/3.677/3.871 sigma repeated at 3 cm, and lower/variable values beyond the peak such as 3.717 sigma at 4 cm and 3.393 sigma at 5 cm. R1 reaches higher raw separation but is not selected because of the hard humidity-ageing constraint; R3 peaks below requirement.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R2 as one of the three candidates: 'porous radiator with a hydrophobic treatment.'

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: The Geant4 simulation for Radiator-R2 at 3.0 cm gave results around 3.8 sigma at 10 GeV/c; the 2025 summary also reports 3.8 sigma at 3 cm. This exceeds 3.5 sigma.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is the candidate specified with a hydrophobic treatment in candidate_specs.md, unlike the unprotected porous R1. The detector vessel is also operated with a dry nitrogen flush per gas_volume.md, further reducing humidity exposure. On this basis R2 is the compliant ageing-robust porous option.
The recommended thickness is 3.0 cm, within the allowed 1--6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
